---
title: "explore_ironman"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(broom)
ironman <- read_csv("phoebechar/ironman/ironman_lake_placid_female_2022.csv")
```

```{r}
ironman_noDom <- ironman |> arrange(desc(Swim.Time)) |> slice(-1)
```

```{r}
ggplot(ironman_noDom, aes(x = Swim.Time, y = Overall.Time, color = Division)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
swim_mod_out <- lm(Overall.Time ~ Swim.Time, ironman)

ironman_residuals = left_join(select(ironman, Name, Overall.Time, Swim.Time) , augment(swim_mod_out))
ironman_residuals |> filter(.cooksd > .5)

swim_mod <- lm(Overall.Time ~ Swim.Time, ironman_noDom)
summary(swim_mod)
```
